subject: Change Order Request: rate exception & SOW phasing for Odyssey Health
messages:
From: Natalie Park <natalie.park@odysseyhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Cole <brian.cole@odysseyhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term rate exception + SOW phasing for pilot expansion

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for yesterday's call. We had a quick procurement follow-up from Finance — Odyssey wants to move the pilot expansion live next month, but need a short-term rate hold for Q3 while legal finalizes the full order form. Can Redwood provide a 2-month rate exception at the earlier T2 pricing band for the additional capacity we scoped (approx. +120k tokens/day)?

Attached is the internal rate schedule Finance shared to explain how they’ll code this in their purchase order.

Key asks:
- Temporary rate exception (2 months) to match T2 per-token seat pricing
- Small SOW change to phase delivery (pilot + ramp) rather than single go-live
- Fast-track signature workflow (DocuSign preferred)

I can loop in our legal if needed; would appreciate a short answer by EOD Friday so we can update the PO.

Thanks,
Natalie
Procurement Manager, Odyssey Health
[Attachment: Odyssey_Rate_Schedule_v2.xlsx]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie.park@odysseyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term rate exception + SOW phasing for pilot expansion

Natalie —

Appreciate the note and the schedule. Short answer: we can offer a temporary rate exception for a 60-day window but need a signed change order that includes the phased SOW and an explicit fallback to normal rates after the term. I looped in Karthik and Laura for pricing and legal language. 

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood to draft a one-page change order that: lists the additional capacity, applies the T2 rate for 60 days, and adds a phased SOW milestone table.
2) Odyssey to confirm billing contact and PO reference for DocuSign.
3) Legal teams to clear a 48-hour review window.

Karthik — can you confirm the exact T2 unit price we should apply and whether finance needs a specific billing code?

Laura — can you prepare a slim change order draft with the fallback clause and a 60-day effective dates block? If you'd prefer, I can attach a starting Word draft.

Natalie — if that plan works I’ll send a draft by tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term rate exception + SOW phasing for pilot expansion

Tessa / Karthik —

Drafted a compact change order (see attached) that accomplishes the ask with minimal legal risk:
- Applies a temporary "Rate Exception" appendix for a 60-day period with start/end dates that are populated on signature.
- Phased SOW table: Pilot (go-live), Ramp (30 days), Steady-state (after 60 days) — each with acceptance criteria.
- Explicit rollback: after the 60-day period the standard Order Form pricing resumes; if both parties agree to extension, a new amendment is required.
- Minimal warranty/indemnity changes; no SOC amendments.

I flagged one item for finance: need the PO reference to match invoice remittance. Markus — can you confirm whether we should accept Odyssey's suggested billing code or require Redwood’s standard code? If we accept theirs it will speed PO processing but creates a glitch in AR reconciliation.

I've attached the Word draft: Proposed_ChangeOrder_Draft_v1.docx

Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Proposed_ChangeOrder_Draft_v1.docx]

From: Natalie Park <natalie.park@odysseyhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Cole <brian.cole@odysseyhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term rate exception + SOW phasing for pilot expansion

Tessa / Laura / Karthik —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Odyssey can accept the one-page change order; Finance confirms they will use PO# OH-2025-1887 and prefer to keep their internal billing code BC-332 (they asked for that in the PO). We understand the rollback clause and the 60-day window.

Please send the DocuSign link when ready and we’ll get legal to countersign ASAP.

Best,
Natalie Park
Procurement Manager, Odyssey Health
